question: Which of the following is a watershed development scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hariyali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Hariyali** is a watershed development scheme launched by the Ministry of Rural Development of India.
 
• The primary aim of the Hariyali scheme is to promote sustainable development and management of watershed areas in rural regions.
 
• It focuses on soil and water conservation, afforestation, and other allied activities to enhance the rural economy.
 
• The scheme encourages community participation and aims to improve the livelihood of rural people by ensuring the availability of water for agricultural and other purposes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Watershed Development**

 
 
• Watershed development refers to the conservation, regeneration, and judicious use of all the resources (natural, human, and social) within a watershed area.
 
• It aims to balance the ecosystem by ensuring water availability, enhancing agricultural productivity, and improving the socio-economic conditions of the people living in the watershed area.
 
• Watershed development programs typically involve activities like soil and water conservation, afforestation, pasture development, rainwater harvesting, and sustainable agricultural practices.
 
• The watershed approach is holistic and integrates various sectors including agriculture, forestry, and water resources management.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Rural Development**
 
 
• The Ministry of Rural Development in India is responsible for the development and welfare of rural areas and communities.
 
• It implements various schemes and programs aimed at alleviating poverty, generating employment, and improving infrastructure and living conditions in rural areas.
 
• Some of the key programs under the Ministry include the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana (Gramin), and National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM).
 
• The Ministry plays a crucial role in addressing the challenges faced by rural communities and ensuring sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development**
 
 
• Sustainable development refers to the development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
 
• It involves a balanced approach to economic growth, social inclusion, and environmental protection.
 
• Sustainable development aims to achieve long-term stability and well-being for both human societies and the natural environment.
 
• Key principles of sustainable development include resource efficiency, environmental stewardship, social equity, and intergenerational responsibility.
